degree.text: Degree Awarded Bachelor Degree of Engineering.

description.text: Teaching Objectives The Civil Engineering programme is designed to educate technical professionals who have a solid foundation, all-round professional knowledge and a good command of design, construction and management of building engineering. Special emphasis is put on innovation, project management, team work and practical capabilities in addition to training of foundation knowledge. The Civil Engineering programme provides graduates with a strong foundation for a career in engineering, together with plan, design, research, construction, and management skills which may be applied in a wide variety of industries. Main Courses Advanced Math, Physics, Theoretical Mechanics, Building materials, Material Mechanics, Structural Mechanics, Soil Mechanics & Foundation Engineering, Concrete Structure, Steel Structure, and Architecture Construction, Elementary Chinese, Survey of China, Intermediate Chinese. Research The school has 6 laboratories: Structural and Seismic Engineering Lab, Wind Tunnel and Wave Flume Joint Lab, Geotechnical and Underground Engineering Lab, Structural Intelligent Monitoring Lab, Structural Blasting and Protection Lab and low temperaturein Civil Engineering Lab. In addition, the school has a High PerformanceComputing center. Advantages of school HIT is one of the first national "Project 211”universities, and is one of China's top nine "Project 985" universities to receive preferential support to achieve the standard of international excellence. The civil engineering discipline in SCE is ranked top 2 in China.The total number of the faculty in the school is 109, including 39 professors and 43 associate professors, among which there are 4 members of Chinese Academy of Engineering (CAE), who have made outstanding achievements in areas of engineering mechanics, large-span space structures, earthquake engineering, wind engineering, structural vibration control, and structural health monitoring. Many distinguished scholars including 1 National Teaching Master, 2 Changjiang Scholar Professors, and other 34 doctoral supervisors are gathered here. Moreover, there are 16 adjunct professors and doctoral supervisors from overseas well-known universities. Internship Practice, course design, surveying and mapping practice, graduation practice, graduation design. Degree Awarded Bachelor Degree of Engineering. Career You will be able to find great jobs in the field of housing construction, tunnel and underground construction, bridge construction and mine companies.

duration.text: The Civil Engineering at Harbin Institute of Technology is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3611 USD/per year ￥ 26000 CNY/per year

materials.text: The application documents in other languages must be notarized in English or Chinese. 1. Log into the HIT online application system to complete the application form. 2. Passport homepage. 3. Senior high school diploma or expected graduation certificate. 4. High school transcript. 5. Language proficiency certificates. Note: Applicants who apply for Chinese Language and Literature do not need to provide language qualification certificates. 6. Recent Physical Examination Record for Foreigner. 7. Non-criminal record report (usually issued within six months before the application submission date). 8. Curriculum Vitae. 9. Remittance voucher of application fee (CNY400/CNY600 ). 10. Certificate of deposit (at least CNY20,000 or equivalent foreign currency). 11. Proof of outstanding academic achievements, sports, art, cultural exchanges, public welfare activities, etc. (not mandatory).

requirements.text: I. Eligibility 1. Applicants must be citizens of a country other than the People's Republic of China. 2. Applicants must be high school diploma holders and under the age of 30. 3. Applicants are in good health both mentally and physically. 4. Applicants must meet minimum language proficiency standards. Chinese-taught programs: HSK level 4≥210 scores (valid for two years). There are no Chinese language proficiency requirements for the applicants of English-taught programs. English-taught programs: TOEFL≥78 scores, IELTS≥6.0 scores, or equivalent English language proficiency certificates.
